items.state_management: React Context handling current slice. Updates force bounded Date range normalized strictly at UTC 00:00:00Z to 23:59:59Z.
items.interaction: Re-fetches GET /api/v1/dashboard/metrics silently without page refresh.

items.validation: IF (BoundarySpan > 365 Days) THEN disable button and visually render message: 'Export limit 12-months exceeded'.
items.error_handling: Catch HTTP 429 (Spam) or HTTP 400. Mask loading state until S3 Pre-signed URL returns, then initiate window.download.

items.formatting: X-Axis dates localized string `YYYY-MM-DD` mapping tightly to underlying UTC ticks. Tooltip must display explicit date and raw revenue increment.
items.fallback: On WebSocket/SSE network sever, silently engage 30s HTTP Polling interval loop.

items.middleware: Expects Bearer JWT. Validates RBAC Territory isolation. Injects queried Temporal boundary bounds.
items.logic: Calculates (Current Bound Revenue / Exactly Equivalent Prior Bound Revenue) for Growth %. If Redis Cache crashes, fails over to MongoDB query and forcibly appends Header `X-Performance-Degraded: true`.
Pushes invalidation `{ event: 'sync_ready', timestamp: <ts> }`. Applies a randomized `0-2000ms` server-side transmission jitter delay per connection to thwart Thundering Herd DdoS onto the GET API.
Validates date constraints (<365 days). Drops request with HTTP 429 if client has an active export already compiling. Dispatches buffer-generation payload to Puppeteer queue.

items.schema_rules: KPI Revenue attribution lock: `owner_id` is permanently anchored to the Sales Rep user at closure timestamp, independently surviving future CRM CRM re-assignments.
items.security: Enforce Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) / Field-Level Encryption explicitly hitting the `booked_revenue` column.

items.caching_strategy: Caches purely serialized metrics JSON payloads. Purged explicitly by active Cron Upsert Pipeline. OOM Failovers trigger application bypass.

items.logic: Polls External CRM via REST for `updated_at > last_sync`. MUST intersect diff live IDs with cached IDs to explicitly identify CRM Hard Deletes and actively purge Mongo ghost records.

items.containerization: Built on a discrete `node:alpine` Docker stage to isolate hefty Chromium binary memory allocations strictly isolating main NestJS event loops.
items.aws_integration: After PDF buffer serialization, issues PutObject to AWS S3 specifically applying target `Expires` metadata to force auto-deletion strictly after 24 hours. Emits HTTPS Pre-signed URL back to Frontend.
